headline: UK-EU reset talks will go ‘down to the wire’ as crunch summit approaches

members.title: What is at stake at the EU-UK summit in Brussels?
members.lead: Leaders will wrestle with easing Brexit red tape, restoring emissions trading and opening up youth mobility UK politics live – latest updates The EU and UK will hold a long-awaited summit in Brussels on Friday – the second since Brexit – to hammer out the UK’s longer-term relationship with the bloc. It will be attended by the prime minister, Andy Burnham, the head of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, and the president of the European Council, António Costa. Continue reading...

members.title: UK-EU reset talks will go ‘down to the wire’ as crunch summit approaches
members.lead: Andy Burnham due in Brussels on Friday but sticking points on food rules and tuition fees remain unresolved The UK-EU reset talks will go “down to the wire” as the British government battles to have a say in shaping future European food and farming rules. With less than 24 hours to go before Andy Burnham is due in Brussels for a summit with EU leaders, the two sides still need to resolve some central sticking points, including how much of a say Britain will have in new EU food rules. Continue reading...
